title: Event-Driven Order Notification System
question:
Design an event-driven notification system for an e-commerce platform:

**Requirements:**
- Order events: OrderCreated, OrderPaid, OrderShipped, OrderDelivered, OrderCancelled
- Notification channels: Email, SMS, Push Notification, In-App
- User preferences for notification channels per event type
- Notification templates with personalization
- Delivery tracking and retry for failed notifications
- Rate limiting per channel (email: 100/min, SMS: 50/min)
- Support for delayed notifications (e.g., "Order delivered 2 days ago, review?")
- Notification history for auditing

**Technical Requirements:**
- Handle 10K orders/hour
- Guarantee at-least-once delivery
- Idempotent notification processing
- Support for notification batching
- Real-time delivery for critical notifications
- Async delivery for non-critical notifications

**Design the complete solution including:**
1. Event schema for order events
2. Event publishing from Order Service
3. Message broker choice (Kafka vs RabbitMQ)
4. Notification service architecture
5. User preference management
6. Template rendering and personalization
7. Multi-channel delivery implementation
8. Retry and dead letter queue handling
9. Rate limiting implementation
10. Monitoring and alerting for delivery failures

title: Event-Sourced Banking Account System
question:
Design an event-sourced banking account system:

**Domain Events:**
- AccountOpened
- DepositMade
- WithdrawalMade
- TransferInitiated
- TransferCompleted
- AccountFrozen
- AccountClosed

**Requirements:**
- Complete audit trail for regulatory compliance
- Point-in-time account balance queries
- Account statement generation for any date range
- Support for account snapshots (monthly)
- Transaction reversal capability
- Fraud detection based on event patterns
- Real-time balance updates
- Concurrent transaction handling

**Technical Requirements:**
- Strong consistency for account balance
- Event versioning for schema evolution
- High write throughput (1000 transactions/sec per account)
- Event retention: 10 years
- Support for CQRS with separate read models
- Real-time projections for current balance
- Historical projections for past balances

**Design and implement:**
1. Event store schema and implementation
2. Aggregate root (Account) design
3. Event handlers and validation
4. Snapshot mechanism
5. Read model projections
6. Temporal queries for historical balance
7. Handling concurrent transactions
8. Event upcasting for schema evolution
9. GDPR compliance (account closure)
10. Testing strategy for event-sourced aggregates

title: Real-Time Inventory Synchronization
question:
Design a real-time inventory synchronization system across multiple channels:

**Channels:**
- Online store
- Mobile app
- Retail POS systems (5000 stores)
- Marketplace integrations (Amazon, eBay)
- Warehouse management system

**Events:**
- InventoryAdjusted
- StockReserved (cart)
- StockReleased (cart abandoned)
- ProductSold
- StockReceived (warehouse)
- StockTransferred (between warehouses)

**Requirements:**
- Real-time inventory updates across all channels
- Prevent overselling
- Handle offline POS systems (eventual consistency)
- Inventory reservations (expire after 15 minutes)
- Audit trail for stock movements
- Support for different inventory allocation rules per channel
- Handle high-frequency updates (100K events/min)

**Design the complete solution including:**
1. Event-driven architecture diagram
2. Kafka topics design and partitioning
3. Inventory service with event sourcing
4. Read models for each channel
5. Reservation mechanism with expiry
6. Conflict resolution for concurrent updates
7. Handling offline POS synchronization
8. Event ordering guarantees
9. Monitoring inventory discrepancies
10. Reconciliation process for data inconsistencies

title: CQRS Blog Platform with Analytics
question:
Design a blog platform using CQRS with rich analytics:

**Write Side (Commands):**
- CreatePost
- UpdatePost
- PublishPost
- UnpublishPost
- DeletePost
- AddComment
- LikePost

**Read Side (Queries):**
- Post detail view
- Author's post list
- Category/tag-based lists
- Search (full-text)
- Trending posts
- Popular authors
- Real-time analytics dashboard
- Comment threads

**Requirements:**
- Separate write and read databases
- Write: PostgreSQL for strong consistency
- Read: Elasticsearch for search, Redis for trending
- Real-time analytics (views, likes, comments per minute)
- Support for 1M daily active users
- Sub-second search response time
- Eventual consistency acceptable for analytics

**Design the complete solution including:**
1. Command model (write side) architecture
2. Query models (read side) for different use cases
3. Event-driven synchronization between models
4. Kafka topics for event streaming
5. Projection services for each read model
6. Handling read model staleness
7. Full-text search implementation
8. Real-time analytics pipeline
9. Cache invalidation strategy
10. Monitoring read model lag

title: Webhook Integration Platform
question:
Design a webhook platform for SaaS application integrations:

**Features:**
- Webhook registration API
- Event filtering and subscriptions
- Signature-based security (HMAC)
- Automatic retry with exponential backoff
- Dead letter queue for failed deliveries
- Webhook testing and replay
- Delivery logs and monitoring
- Rate limiting per subscriber

**Events to Support:**
- User events (created, updated, deleted)
- Transaction events
- Data change events
- System events

**Requirements:**
- Handle 100K webhook deliveries/minute
- Guarantee at-least-once delivery
- Support for 10K subscribers
- Delivery success rate >99%
- Retry up to 5 times with exponential backoff
- Subscriber notification for persistent failures
- Webhook payload size limit: 1MB

**Design the complete solution including:**
1. Webhook registration and management API
2. Event subscription and filtering
3. Signature generation and verification
4. Async webhook delivery architecture (queue-based)
5. Retry mechanism with exponential backoff
6. Circuit breaker for unhealthy endpoints
7. Dead letter queue handling
8. Delivery logs and history
9. Monitoring and alerting
10. Testing and debugging tools for developers

title: Travel Booking with Distributed Saga
question:
Design a travel booking system using saga pattern:

**Services Involved:**
- Flight Booking Service
- Hotel Booking Service
- Car Rental Service
- Payment Service
- Notification Service

**Booking Flow:**
1. Reserve flight
2. Reserve hotel
3. Reserve car
4. Process payment
5. Confirm all bookings
6. Send confirmation email

**Failure Scenarios:**
- Payment failure → cancel all reservations
- Hotel unavailable → cancel flight and car
- Timeout in any service → rollback
- Partial network failures

**Requirements:**
- Orchestration-based saga
- Compensating transactions for each step
- Timeout handling (30 seconds per service)
- Idempotent operations
- Saga state persistence
- Support for manual intervention
- Audit trail for booking flow

**Design and implement:**
1. Saga orchestrator architecture
2. State machine for booking saga
3. Compensating transactions for each service
4. Timeout and failure handling
5. Idempotency mechanism
6. Saga state persistence (database)
7. Event publishing and consumption
8. Monitoring stuck sagas
9. Manual intervention UI
10. Testing saga scenarios (success and failure)

title: Real-Time Activity Feed System
question:
Design a real-time activity feed system (like Twitter/LinkedIn feed):

**Activities:**
- Post created
- Post liked
- Post commented
- User followed
- User mentioned
- Share activity

**Requirements:**
- Real-time feed updates (WebSocket)
- Personalized feed per user
- Feed pagination with infinite scroll
- Activity aggregation ("John and 5 others liked your post")
- Historical feed (last 30 days)
- Feed ranking/relevance
- Notification generation from activities

**Technical Requirements:**
- 10M active users
- Handle 1M activities/minute
- Feed load time <200ms
- Real-time delivery <1 second
- Fan-out for popular users (millions of followers)
- Support for different feed algorithms

**Design the complete solution including:**
1. Event schema for activities
2. Kafka topics and partitioning strategy
3. Feed fanout strategy (push vs pull vs hybrid)
4. Handling celebrity users with millions of followers
5. Feed storage (Redis for hot data, Cassandra for cold)
6. Real-time delivery via WebSocket
7. Feed ranking and personalization
8. Activity aggregation logic
9. Notification generation from feed
10. Caching and performance optimization

title: IoT Event Processing Pipeline
question:
Design an event processing pipeline for IoT sensor data:

**Data Sources:**
- 1 million IoT devices
- Each device sends metrics every 10 seconds
- Metrics: temperature, humidity, pressure, battery

**Processing Requirements:**
- Real-time anomaly detection
- Alert generation on threshold violations
- Data aggregation (per minute, hour, day)
- Historical trend analysis
- Device health monitoring
- Predictive maintenance alerts

**Technical Requirements:**
- Handle 100K events/second
- Real-time processing (<1 second latency)
- Store raw data for 90 days
- Store aggregated data for 5 years
- Support for complex event processing (CEP)
- Time-series data optimization

**Design the complete solution including:**
1. Event ingestion from IoT devices (MQTT, HTTP)
2. Kafka topics design for sensor data
3. Stream processing with Kafka Streams
4. Real-time anomaly detection algorithm
5. Alert generation and notification
6. Data aggregation pipeline
7. Time-series database selection (InfluxDB, TimescaleDB)
8. Historical data retention and archival
9. Monitoring and alerting for pipeline health
10. Handling late-arriving data and out-of-order events
